decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program draws on the firm's existing domestic manufacturing and logistics know-how, so it can interpret delivery results and refine the offer, and it stayed visible on the website in both years.

The seventy-two-hour program extends established spare-parts and production logistics capabilities, but it is operationally demanding and may later be merged into the broader express line, so the risk is slightly higher.
The express line for doors and gates has its own page and several models and builds directly on the firm's core door and gate competence, making it a well-absorbed, central offering.
The digital ordering and services platform supports trade partners and the service network, and the firm can learn steadily from its usage data, so it fits the move toward deeper service support.

The fire and smoke protection door builds on certified safety and fire-protection engineering, was promoted to its own page in 2024, and likely absorbed what the firm learned from the withdrawn fire-resistant exterior door C.
